items.title: August Laurent Interview, 1960-03-21
items.q: My cousin gave Louis Armstrong his first trumpet in the home.

ctx.x: I know Dr. Bache told me once that he took him down and tried to get him to put him in the home or something. That's right. The police said, no, you take him home, you raise him.

Same way with Louis Armstrong. Louis Armstrong was in the home. My cousin gave Louis Armstrong his first trumpet in the home. He was in charge of the boys out there. And he gave Louis Armstrong, Trump started Louis with trumpet. Now who is that?
Was that Peter Davis or another man? It was a man that died last year, two years ago.
